main_text.head: EXERC. XVI.
UTRUM PARTIS SIMULA-ris materia per se ullis possit affligi morbis?
main_text.p: 1.Jam uero ad illos materiae partis fimilaris morbos, quos ipse Fernelius libro de Abditis rerum caufis fecundo, capite nono, & de Morborum differentiis, capite feptimo tanquam nouos & inauditos suo iure statuit, progredi tempestiuum est. Hi autem sunt durities, mollities, crassities, tenuitas, densitas, astrictio & laxitas, quos omnes immoderationis materiae partis similaris constituit. Verum rationes, quibus huiusmodi morbos confirmare conatur, producere & simul examinare nobis cōuenit: quarum prima est partium similariū actiones posse laedi sano temperamento: ii.altera, multorum hominum uentriculos nec acetum ferre, neq; sinapi. iij.Tertia, nonnullos quibusdam odoribus supra modū aut delectari, aut offendi: iv.quarta, morbos uentriculi, & hepatis astringentia perpetuò postulare: v.Postrema, immoderate laxantia uires diffoluere. Quod ad primam attinet, illam diluere operosum non erit. [illegible, ~3 letters]Nullius

page.notes: Printed "neq;" and "namq;" kept as printed. Marginal note numerals on the right are partly faint: "ii.", "iij.", "iv." are uncertain readings. The last margin mark is unreadable. The small ornaments (») at line ends are not transcribed as text. Long s normalised to s; u/v and i/j normalised per the rules (VTRVM to UTRUM, SIMVLA to SIMULA, fimilaris to similaris, Iam to Jam). The drop-cap I is joined to the first word. Printed "s" forms in the word "fimila-ris" are rendered as s. Printed "durities" and "pro-ducere" text is copied as seen; a hyphen at the end of "pro-" and "tempestiuum est" line breaks is handled as printed.
